description: Geographic reference matrix for Oregon Exterior Experts content localization. Soil/geology, tree/biological load, and regulation data for each service city. Pull directly from this matrix — do not fabricate geological, biological, or regulatory details.

Portland.soil_geology: Portland Hills Silt over Missoula Flood deposits; Boring Lava basalt in east hills
Portland.tree_biological_load: Heavy urban canopy — Douglas fir, big leaf maple, western red cedar. High moss/algae pressure year-round.
Portland.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Portland Title 24 stormwater overlay; Tree Code Title 11.50 (canopy preservation)

Beaverton.soil_geology: Tualatin Valley silty clay loam; poor subsurface drainage in low-lying areas
Beaverton.tree_biological_load: Mixed deciduous/conifer; moderate canopy. Leaf litter clogs gutters Oct–Jan.
Beaverton.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Beaverton Development Code Ch. 60 (Clean Water Services stormwater standards)

Lake Oswego.soil_geology: Iron-rich basalt (historic Oswego Iron Furnace); dense clay over basalt bedrock
Lake Oswego.tree_biological_load: Mature canopy — Douglas fir, western red cedar. Heavy shade drives aggressive moss colonization.
Lake Oswego.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Lake Oswego Municipal Code Ch. 55 (tree protection); Sensitive Lands overlay

Tigard.soil_geology: Tualatin Valley clay; Fanno Creek alluvial deposits with seasonal high water table
Tigard.tree_biological_load: Mixed forest along Fanno Creek corridor; moderate biological load. Seasonal alder leaf drop.
Tigard.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Tigard Municipal Code Ch. 18.510 (Clean Water Services drainage); Fanno Creek setback rules

Hillsboro.soil_geology: Deep Willamette Silt; agricultural valley floor with compacted subsoils from farm use
Hillsboro.tree_biological_load: Lower canopy density (former agricultural land); reduced moss pressure but high orchard/pollen debris.
Hillsboro.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Hillsboro Municipal Code Ch. 12.40 (stormwater); Clean Water Services standards

Gresham.soil_geology: Boring Lava Field basalt; volcanic ash soils; Sandy River alluvium in north sections
Gresham.tree_biological_load: Heavy Douglas fir and western hemlock. Powell Butte proximity drives high spore/moss load.
Gresham.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Gresham Development Code Sec. 9.0500 (stormwater/erosion); Pleasant Valley overlay

Salem.soil_geology: Willamette Silt; Woodburn clay series with seasonal shrink-swell behavior
Salem.tree_biological_load: Valley oaks, Oregon ash, moderate canopy. Agricultural buffer reduces moss but increases pollen/silt.
Salem.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Salem Revised Code Ch. 75 (stormwater); Willamette Greenway overlay

West Linn.soil_geology: Basalt hardpan; perched water tables with limited vertical drainage
West Linn.tree_biological_load: Dense canopy — Douglas fir, bigleaf maple. Canemah Bluffs microclimate drives heavy moss/lichen.
West Linn.regulation: 2026 ORSC; West Linn Municipal Code Ch. 32 (tree ordinance); Bolton neighborhood stormwater overlay

Sherwood.soil_geology: Jory clay (red volcanic); orchard silt accumulation from Tualatin Valley agriculture
Sherwood.tree_biological_load: Mixed orchard remnants/conifer; moderate biological load. Seasonal fruit drop and silt film on surfaces.
Sherwood.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Sherwood Municipal Code Ch. 16.116 (stormwater); Clean Water Services standards

Newberg.soil_geology: Jory clay; Chehalem Mountain volcanic soils; Willamette silt in valley floor
Newberg.tree_biological_load: Vineyard/orchard dominant; lower canopy density. Less moss pressure but high mineral dust and pollen.
Newberg.regulation: 2026 ORSC; Newberg Municipal Code Ch. 15.235 (stormwater); Yamhill County ag-buffer setbacks

Vancouver.soil_geology: Columbia River flood deposits; glacial outwash gravel over basalt; seasonal high water table
Vancouver.tree_biological_load: Mixed conifer/deciduous — Douglas fir, red alder, Oregon white oak. Moderate to heavy moss load.
Vancouver.regulation: Washington State Building Code (WSBC) / 2021 IRC adoption; Vancouver Municipal Code Ch. 14.25 (stormwater); Clark County Critical Areas ordinance
